summary: Master project lessons learned and knowledge management with practical templates, workshops, and reporting tools. Enrol to improve project learning.
lede: Project lessons learned and knowledge management help project professionals turn delivery experience into reusable knowledge. This training is for people working in projects, project controls, documentation, or knowledge processes who need to make lessons useful across projects; it covers facilitating lesson capture, analysing and categorising findings, and storing knowledge for retrieval and reuse.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with projects, project controls, documentation, or knowledge processes and need a better way to convert experience into reusable project learning.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and familiarity with basic project documentation. If available, bring a recent project closeout pack, risk register, issue log, or previous lessons learned report for use in exercises.
